summary_en: 20,938,007 shares acquired at ¥1,580/share, totaling ¥33.1B. Tender offer closed 2026-08-03. Shinko Shoji (8141) becomes consolidated subsidiary of KAGA Electronics (8154) effective 2026-08-10. Represents 70.7% of Shinko's shares outstanding ex-treasury.
title_en: Announcement of Results of Public Tender Offer for Ordinary Shares of Shinko Shoji Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 8141) and Notification of Change in Subsidiary Status (Change in Specified Subsidiary)
translation_en_brief: KAGA Electronics Co., Ltd. (ticker 8154) filed a public tender offer on 2026-05-18 to acquire ordinary shares of Shinko Shoji Co., Ltd. (ticker 8141, Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market). The offer price was ¥1,580 per share, with an execution window of 55 business days through 2026-08-03. The tender offer specified a floor threshold of 15,988,500 shares but no ceiling. A total of 20,938,007 shares were tendered and accepted, exceeding the minimum threshold and resulting in an aggregate acquisition cost of approximately ¥33.1 billion. This represents 70.7% of Shinko Shoji's outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock of 1,397,967 shares as of 2026-03-31). Settlement and delivery of purchased shares will commence on 2026-08-10, at which date Shinko Shoji will become a consolidated subsidiary of KAGA Electronics and will be classified as a specified subsidiary for financial reporting purposes. KAGA Electronics held 515,000 shares of Shinko Shoji prior to the offer commencement.
